title: A. Internal-only inference through a private regional WAF
subtitle: The private listener, origin and Foundry path were tested from an isolated Azure verifier. Corporate VPN, ExpressRoute, firewall and hub transit are reference dependencies, not a live corporate-network claim.

groups.title: Client and directory boundaries - corporate reachability must be supplied
Customer Azure subscription - private inference path; one APIM governance boundary
Separate subnet and service boundaries - address space and resource IDs come from discovery
Monitoring and optional estate - independent deployment decisions, not silently converted

nodes.title: Corporate developer
lines: Claude Code, VS Code extension or Desktop
HTTPS/443 to the private listener, with the person's Entra bearer token.
A real VPN/ExpressRoute route and private DNS are prerequisites. Internet-only clients lose this path.

nodes.title: Microsoft Entra ID
lines: Public HTTPS/443 sign-in and refresh; delegated OAuth.
Existing tenant policy supplies MFA/Conditional Access.
A directory service, not an ARM resource inside the VNet. No new tenant-admin consent.

nodes.title: Corporate hub - reference only
lines: Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworkGateways
VPN or ExpressRoute, peering and return routes; discover existing ownership.
HTTPS/443 continues to the spoke's private WAF. No corporate tunnel was deployed or tested in P54.

nodes.title: Private WAF v2 listener
lines: [[edge]]
[[waf]]
Dedicated edge subnet; HTTPS/443 only.
Separate global and Messages policies; body inspection and enforcement stay on.
TLS to APIM; bearer unchanged. Socket-derived client-IP headers replace caller values.

nodes.title: APIM Standard v2
lines: Microsoft.ApiManagement/service
Inbound Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints; public access disabled.
Source filter before JWT, entitlement and budgets; direct private bypass is rejected.
Separate outbound integration subnet, delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms.
HTTPS/443 to Foundry with APIM managed identity, not the developer token.

nodes.title: Customer Foundry deployment
lines: Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts
Private endpoint on the account subresource; public access disabled.
HTTPS/443; APIM identity has the scoped inference role.
Claude response streams back over the same TLS path; WAF response buffering is off.
An inbound endpoint does not itself isolate Foundry Agent Service egress.

nodes.title: VNet and exclusive subnets
lines: Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks
[[nsg]]
Edge: dedicated /24 recommended; modern gateway delegation when enabled.
APIM integration: /27 minimum, /24 recommended. Endpoints: separate, non-delegated.
Verifier: separate Container Instances delegation; temporary test workload.

nodes.title: Certificate, not a developer key
lines: Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults
[[certificate-identity]]
Edge MI: HTTPS/443 via vault PE; Secrets User and a versionless certificate reference.
Private administration. Evaluation returns a public CA only; production uses an approved issuer.

nodes.title: Private DNS is not a subnet
lines: Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones
[[dns-a]]
Exact listener name points to private frontend. Service zones link to reachable VNets.
Resolver forwarding: DNS UDP/TCP 53. Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints need separate exclusive subnets.
A shared zone in another subscription is retained, never guessed or overwritten.

nodes.title: Telemetry and access impact
lines: Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces and Microsoft.Insights/components
Azure-managed diagnostics; not an invented VNet hop. SDK/query traffic uses HTTPS/443.
Trusted client IP and gateway request ID enter the ledger; scrub prompt/header match data.
AMPLS is a separate, reference-only choice. Masked historical IPs cannot prove client reachability.

nodes.title: Optional workloads, own subnets
lines: Resolver: Microsoft.Web/sites -> Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts; HTTPS/443, reader MI.
Turnstile: App Service -> Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers; TLS/5432, server-side identity/credential.
Microsoft.App/jobs in a separate managed environment; HTTPS/443 to ARM/logs with scoped MI.
Their private conversion is not automated by the regional edge review.

nodes.title: Explicit reference alternatives
lines: Microsoft.Network/azureFirewalls: destination policy plus approved UDR/return routing.
NAT supplies SNAT, not an allowlist or inspection.
Premium v2 injection needs a new instance and Microsoft.Web/hostingEnvironments subnet.
Direct app-spoke APIM access skips WAF and is deliberately rejected by this edge-only policy.

notice: Live boundary: private verifier -> private WAF -> private APIM -> private Foundry; internet TLS and direct APIM bypass were refused. Corporate hub, HA, Premium injection and optional-estate paths remain reference-only. All evaluation resources were removed.
